rca_of_issue: RCA (backend): detach_photo() performs update_one with owner-scoped _id + photos.file_id filter but ignores update result and always returns 204. Repro: user A uploads photo; user B DELETE same draft/file endpoint -> receives 204 (expected 404). Mitigation: inspect matched_count/modified_count and raise HTTPException(404, 'Photo not found.') when no owner-match exists.
